 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Color 9 forms full separator lines; tile the motif from the occupied cell.
    rs = [r for r in range(n) if all(v == 9 for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(m) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(n))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [n]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [m]
    regions = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # Find the region with the most non-background cells, retaining coordinates
    # relative to the upper-left corner of that region.
    def cells(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return [(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != 7]
    motif = max((cells(b) for b in regions), key=len)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for dr,dc,v in motif:
            if r0+dr<r1 and c0+dc<c1:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=v
    return out
